subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar keep a permanent top-level Usage & Spend Settings destination, or embed this cross-provider aggregation in an existing shared overview?
rationale: The implementation can support either layout, but VISION.md reserves new feature surfaces and meaningful maintenance complexity for maintainer sign-off and favors shared provider-driven UI.

options.title: Integrate shared overview
options.body: Keep the aggregation model but present it within an existing shared overview to avoid another permanent top-level destination.

options.title: Approve dedicated pane
options.body: Accept the spend-first dashboard as a permanent Settings sidebar destination and own its additional navigation and maintenance surface.

options.title: Decline the dashboard
options.body: Keep provider-specific charts and local cost output as the supported exploration paths without adding cross-provider Settings UI.

recommendation.title: Integrate shared overview
recommendation.body: Keep the aggregation model but present it within an existing shared overview to avoid another permanent top-level destination.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner defines the product vision and is the strongest available owner for permanent Settings information architecture.
